key_insight: Mem++ preserves full document history and shifts memory selection to query time, enabling LLM agents to answer time-sensitive organizational questions without destructive summarization.
engineering_relevance: This design is important for production LLM systems that must track evolving decisions and versioned records accurately over long time horizons.
method: Store each document intact with its timestamp and author; no write-time generation or compression.
At read time, filter to documents dated no later than the question’s reference time.
Fuse lexical and semantic retrieval rankings before passing context to the answering model.
evidence_signal: On OrgMemBench, Mem++ outperforms the strongest memory baseline by 8.0 to 13.1 points across two answering models, and with gpt-4.1-mini it scores 2.6 points above RAG overall.
watch_item: Keeping all document versions may increase storage and retrieval complexity, so systems need efficient indexing and time-aware retrieval at scale.
paper_title: Mem++: Non-Destructive Memory for Long-Term Organizational LLM Agents
